reviewer: GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh recovery independent audit instance
findings: The queue, packet and live receipt SHA-256 independently agree at abb33c7a777b1604cf91315456d003dae5ac0a6341219688a35e4dc7d858facd. The canonical fingerprint recomputes to a570e2b3b2becb2534fa852e6033688129fa7b1caf547ab4b033b0cb21b0b4ba, the implementation digest recomputes to 7a34c7391e42c11c5e31ba8f53f176e736a67f39a1754a0ec9af97a455ae233f, all 37 provenance inputs match their bytes, and both predecessor fingerprints validate.

Fresh WSL rehashing reproduces the physical 17,920-byte llama-server SHA-256 efb2f06c19d26605a1934c0a9ed5b65dd69034e8765f2d29d0426b7a011cfbe2 and the 17,923,394,624-byte Qwen3.8 model SHA-256 bee238bbeb3dc0a34bde4d0dedbaee1f98c009e8bb4226f03070054c12fb1372. The retained systemd and /proc identities bind one zero-restart PID to q4_0/q4_0 KV, --spec-type draft-mtp, --spec-draft-n-max 3, one slot and the isolated save path.

Independent row reconstruction finds exactly 16 ordered cycles, indices 0 through 15, with 16 unique deterministic prompts and prompt-set SHA-256 c1e0e6984ba4b5dd36d6619b63c62aa4b561c41b305f935918c8c8be2d99172b. Every erase/save/erase/restore/complete/erase action succeeds, every save and restore reports 6,744 tokens, every captured slot file is 281,362,032 bytes, and all 16 slot SHA-256 values are distinct. All finalized projections exactly match the source rows.

Serialization is therefore observed, but functional prefix reuse is not. Every restored completion reports cache_n=0, evaluates the full 6,739-token prompt, yields cache fraction 0 and prefill-token reduction 0. The independently recomputed medians are cold prompt_n 6,739, warm prompt_n 6,739, cache fraction 0 and prefill reduction 0; zero of sixteen cycles satisfy positive cache reuse.

The retained server journal independently contains 32 prompt-evaluation records, two per cycle, and all 32 evaluate 6,739 tokens under the same physical PID. Median paired prompt-time reduction is only 0.0002337, with mixed signs across cycles, so missing cache_n telemetry is not a plausible false-negative explanation for the reuse result.

All sixteen cold/warm continuations are exactly equal and contain their cycle-specific CEDAR code, but this is deterministic content parity under the same seed and greedy settings, not evidence of cache reuse. Treating exact continuation, n_restored or a nonempty slot file alone as functional reuse would be the principal false positive; the three preregistered reuse gates jointly prevent it.

Recorded maintenance stopped the persistent service through systemd, left embedding running, removed the isolated transient unit/save directory and restored qwen38. Fresh checks find llm-inference active with zero restarts, the qwen38 backend healthy, embedding HTTP 200, the transient unit absent and its save directory removed.

Approval signs only MTP_PERSISTENCE_FUNCTIONAL_REUSE_REJECTED_R3 for this exact runtime, model, q4_0 KV configuration, prompt construction and sixteen same-process save/erase/restore cycles. It does not reject file serialization, nor establish cross-process persistence, crash recovery, general MTP persistence failure, cross-model behavior, production durability or performance.
